Class JsonObject

java.lang.Object
be.imgn.json.JsonObject
All Implemented Interfaces:
JsonValue
public final class JsonObject extends Object implements JsonValue

A JSON object: members with distinct names, in the order of the document or of their insertion.

An object parsed from a document is lazy: it creates each member's value on its first access, and keeps the document in memory while it is referenced. copyOf(JsonObject) makes a copy that does not.

Two objects are equal when they have the same members, whatever their order, as two Maps are.

Since:
0.1.0
